sentences.text: As per FIR, there was an allegation against the petitioners are that they embezzled an amount of Rs.67,90,760/-.
Thereafter a compromise has been arrived at between the parties and out of which Rs.11,00,000/- an odd figure said to have been returned.
Except Section 420 of IPC other offences are not compoundable.

For compoundable offences, let appropriate application be filed before the Trial Court, who shall verify the factum of compromise arrived at between the parties and for the remaining sections thereafter the petitioner may approach this Court under section 482 of Cr.P.C for quashment of the FIR/chargesheet.

If the charges are not framed, the trial Court may consider this compromise under Section 227 of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the petition stands dismissed.
(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE das Prachi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103884335/
